Present report shows the possibilities of the special programme support that has the capacity to define the current level of measurement accuracy within certain limits, and hence to adjust the output parameters.

articleTitle: Measurements with a Fourier Transform Wavemeter
abstract: In this paper we describe the results of wavelength comparisons of lasers done with a Fourier Transform (FT) spectrometer in the visible and near infrared region. The spectrometer employs the Fast Fourier Transformation (FFT) routine to determine absolute wavelengths and mode structures of mono- and multi-mode lasers relative to a stabilized He-Ne (633 nm) laser.

articleTitle: Development of a calibration system for magnetic field standard by feederless loop antennas
abstract: A magnetie field strength standard is developed using two feederless hollow loop antennas containing eleetronic components. Optical fibers are used for measuring transmitting loop current and e.m.f. induced on the receiving loop. Magnetic field strengths evaluated independently by the transmitting loop and by the receiving loop are compared.

articleTitle: A compact sun tracking radiometer with two different beam width antennas for detection of atmospheric water vapor
abstract: A compact radiometer system having two small antennas of different beam widths was developed to detect water vapor concentration by measuring atmospheric attenuation of the sun radiation at K-band. Experimental results have shown general agreement in the trend of theoretically calculated ones against absolute humidity at ground level.

articleTitle: Reconstruction of Magnetic Flux Density as Vector Quantity by CT Technique
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel method for imaging the magnetic field as a vector quantity, applying CT technique to the electromagnetic induction phenomenon generated in a conductor moving in the magnetic field.

articleTitle: High-Precision Automated Resistance Measurement Using a Modified Wheatstone Bridge
abstract: We report a modified Wheatstone bridge which has four detectors to sense the imbalance in the circuit. The bridge auto-balances using a microcomputer controlled feedback system, and a precision of better than 0.01 ppm is estimated.

articleTitle: Self-Balancing Resistance Ratio Bridge Using a Cryogenic Current Comparator
A Re-Evaluation of the NML Absolute OHM and Quantized Hall Resistance Determinations
abstract: The NML calculable capacitor has been examined for possible adjustment errors and for the effects of wear. A new program of measurements relating the 1-/spl Omega/ standards to the calculable capacitor and to the QHR has been conducted, and the results are presented.

articleTitle: The Evaluation of Uncertainty and the Adjustment of Fundamental Constants
abstract: The uncertainty and fundamental constants are of importance for measurement. This paper deals with the evaluation of uncertainty. Many good methods are contributed. It is essential to obtain the optimum values of fundamental constants by proper adjustment. Some useful results of proper adjustment are obtained here.

articleTitle: Comparison of the Quantum Hall Resistance and OHM NRC
abstract: We report on the progress towards the establishment of a quantum Hall resistance measurement system suitable for maintaining OHM NRC. This new system will be described and compared to the previously reported 15T, 20 mK potentiometric system. General problems concerning utilization of the Hall resistance as a unit will be discussed.

articleTitle: Practical Iodine Stabilized He-Ne Laser
Surface Mounted Parts Inspection and Correction for PC Board Warpage
abstract: Because of the increase popularity of high-density PC boards, conventional insertion parts are giving way to smaller surface-mounted parts. However, compared with the insertion parts, surface-mounted parts are frequently misaligned on the PC board, making visual inspection essential. Many inspection machines are available, but inspectors are still required because the machines are prone to error caused by irregular reflections off the solder or due to warped PC boards. High-accuracy inspection equipment for surface-mounted parts is required.

articleTitle: A Precision Current Transformers Used for Audio Frequency Power Standard
abstract: A precision current transformer of audio frequency has been developed, in which an auxiliary current transformer is introduced to equalize the potential along the primary and secondary winding of the main current transformer, resulting a dramatic reduction of capacitive leakage current. In this way, a ratio error less than 10 ppm and phase angle error less than 10 rad have been achieved at the frequency up to 15000 Hz.

articleTitle: An Inversion Method for the Measurement of Sensitivity Distribution in the Field of View of an IR Radiometer
abstract: A new inversion method for the measurement of sensitivity distribution in the field of view of a thermal infrared radiometer is proposed. The sensitivity distribution is obtained from the radiometer output by using a transmission computed tomography algorithm. The output is acquired while a plate blackbody with straight edge is scanning across the field of view of the radiometer. We used the fact that the time differential of the output corresponds to the projection data in computed tomography.

articleTitle: The EMF-Temperature Formula of the Unsaturated Cadmium Sulfate Standard Cell from 0 to 50/spl deg/C
Amorphous Ribbons Used for a Magnetostrictive Digitizer
abstract: It was found that the thickness of amorphous ribbons changed periodically and the period in length corresponded to the circumference of the quenching roll. The accuracy of the mass-produced digitizer was improved by taking into account this periodicity to select the even ribbons in thickness.

articleTitle: High-Precision Measuring Apparatus for Quantum-Hall-Effect Resistance Standard
abstract: The measuring apparatus consists of (i) a resistance comparator, (ii) superstable standard resistors, calibrated to the quantized Hall resistance and (iii) a transportable thermostabilized divider for a transfer from quantized (6453.2 Ohm) to decimal resistance (100 Ohm). The apparatus may be used also to compare and measure resistance with an accuracy to 0.01 ppm.

articleTitle: Experiment on the Absolute Measurement of A Silicon Lattice Spacing at the NRLM
abstract: An improvement of the x-ray and optical interferometer system is in progress for the absolute determination of the silicon

articleTitle: Accuracy of Measurements of the Quantised Hall Resistivity by a Direct Current Comparator Type Potentiometer: Calibration Using a Josephson Potentiometer
A Study on the Effect of Irregularities on the Electrodes of the Calculable Cross-Capacitor
abstract: A sensitivity function Is utilized to analyze the capacitance errors due to surface irregularitles on the electrodes of a Lampard-Thompson calculable cross-capacitor. With this function the property of compensation of the mean of the two cross-capacitances is verifled also for non cylindrical irregularities and the possibility to compute corrections terms dependent on the position of the moving electrode is shown.

articleTitle: Stabilization of the CO/sub 2/ Laser Power by Feedback Controlling Through the Auxiliary Electrode
abstract: The output power of the CW CO2 laser is stabilized by the feedback control of the electrical discharge. The variance of the stabilized output power is reduced to 10% of the unstabilized output power variance.

articleTitle: Position Error Caused By Observed Phase Errors In The GPS Receiver: Prestar
abstract: This paper begins with a principle of positioning using the GPS receiver: PRESTAR. It measures phase differences of the C/A code clock, the P code clock and the L1, L2 carriers. Consequently, results from these tests are described. The observed phase errors are less than one degree in the C/A and P codes, and about ten degrees in the L1 and L2 carriers. The phase errors in both carriers correspond to an error of several mm in the pseudo-range and cause a position error of 1-3 cm.

articleTitle: Measurement of 4 terminal-pair capacitors ranging from 1 pF to 1 /spl mu/F at frequencies up to 100 kHz
abstract: The measurement method and the definition of 4-TP capacitors measured at LCIE in terms of capacitance and loss factor are described in this paper. The bridge developed for this purpose allows measurements of capacitors ranging from 1 pF to 1 hf in the frequency band 1-100 kHz.

articleTitle: High Speeding of the Gloss-Meter for Curved Surfaces Using CCD Line Sensor
abstract: The gloss-meter using a CCD line-sensor, electronic circuits and a single-board computer was developed for curved surfaces, accordance with a new definition of glossiness. Also, by the improvement of an optical system in this meter, a high speeding of measurement and an error reducing were realized.

articleTitle: Property Of One Cylinder Type Standard Cell
abstract: Two kinds of new one-cylinder type standard cells were developed for the purposes of lower internal resistances of the standard cell and less influences of temperature fluctuation in oil baths on standard cell measurements. Properties of these new type cells are almost the same as those of normal shape cells.
